scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT/TD-DFT results is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; scoring uses the agent's reported CSVs and compares to paper-reported reference values with tolerances plus structural checks (N-bonded isomer minimum, correct sign of ΔE, LHE recompute consistency).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference relative energies (B3LYP, kcal/mol) from paper Table 2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 B3LYP column; values for complexes 1-9,4'-9'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Matches the paper's reported quantitative results for the N-bonding vs S-bonding stability.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected sign of ΔE_HS‑LS (positive=LS ground, negative=HS ground) from paper's text and Figure 1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper discussion and Figure 1; LS for Ru(II),Co(III); HS for Fe(II),Co(II),Fe(III) except complex 6' which is LS.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's spin-state assignments.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Structural rule deducible from the paper; prevents arbitrary reporting while tolerating code-based energy differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference harmonic vibrational frequencies (cm⁻¹) for [Ru(dcqtpy)(NCS)₂] LS against experimental data, and approximate ranges for Fe(II) C≡N stretch.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Experimental values reported in paper: C≡N 2097, C=O 1710, O–H 3371. Fe LS ~2100, HS ~2050 from experimental literature cited.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Experimental data cited in the paper; Fe values derived from typical ranges discussed in the text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are externally known experimental benchmarks used to validate the computational protocol.

outputs.description: Quantifies the thermodynamic preference for N-bonding vs S-bonding of the CNS ligand.
Determines the ground spin state for each complex; positive ΔE_HS-LS indicates LS ground state, negative indicates HS ground state.
Provides a vibrational benchmark for the quality of the DFT functional; these frequencies can be compared against experimental literature values.
Documents the structural differences between spin states and isomer configurations.
Simulates the UV-vis absorption profiles of the sensitizers and evaluates their light-harvesting capability.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are compared against hidden paper-reported reference values with tolerances appropriate for re-running DFT/TD-DFT with a different code (ORCA vs Gaussian) and basis set implementation. The specific tolerances are hidden.
